key: "For Heather,
en: "For Heather,
ja: 「ヘザーへ、

key: By the time you read this, you will be strong.
en: By the time you read this, you will be strong.
ja: これを読む頃には、あなたはもう強くなっているでしょう。

key: I was not raised to be strong.
en: I was not raised to be strong.
ja: わたしは、強くあるようにとは育てられませんでした。

key: I was raised to be naive, and I suffered for it.
en: I was raised to be naive, and I suffered for it.
ja: 世間知らずであるようにと育てられ、そのせいで苦しみました。

key: I shall not make this same mistake with you.
en: I shall not make this same mistake with you.
ja: あなたには、同じ過ちを繰り返させません。

key: Reality is cruel.
en: Reality is cruel.
ja: 現実は残酷なものです。

key: This, I learned the hard way.
en: This, I learned the hard way.
ja: それを、わたしは痛い目に遭って学びました。

key: This, you have grown to learn from the second you were born.
en: This, you have grown to learn from the second you were born.
ja: あなたは、生まれた瞬間から、それを学びながら育ってきました。

key: I told you long ago how she passed.
en: I told you long ago how she passed.
ja: 彼女がどのようにして亡くなったのかは、ずっと以前にあなたへ話しましたね。

key: I did not mention who was responsible for it.
en: I did not mention who was responsible for it.
ja: 誰の仕業だったのかは、話しませんでした。

key: Team Meteor sought to cleanse the city and restore it to its former heritage-- a holy site.
en: Team Meteor sought to cleanse the city and restore it to its former heritage-- a holy site.
ja: チームメテオは、この街を浄化し、かつての姿――聖地としての姿を取り戻そうとしていました。

key: To this end, they take no prisoners.
en: To this end, they take no prisoners.
ja: その目的のためなら、彼らは誰も容赦しません。

key: I was forced to join their ranks, but I did so to sabotage them.
en: I was forced to join their ranks, but I did so to sabotage them.
ja: わたしは強制的に彼らの一員に加えられましたが、それは内側から彼らを妨害するためでした。

key: Specifically, I sought the head of the man who killed your mother.
en: Specifically, I sought the head of the man who killed your mother.
ja: 具体的には、あなたの母を殺した男の首を狙っていました。

key: He was after an artifact I foolishly bestowed upon her.
en: He was after an artifact I foolishly bestowed upon her.
ja: その男は、わたしが愚かにもあなたの母に与えてしまったアーティファクトを狙っていたのです。

key: He saw her life as a small price to pay for it.
en: He saw her life as a small price to pay for it.
ja: あの男は、それを手に入れるためなら、あなたの母の命など安いものだと考えていました。

key: I will see to it that he pays what's due in his own blood.
en: I will see to it that he pays what's due in his own blood.
ja: あの男には、必ず自らの血で、その代償を払わせます。

key: If you will join me, I will have you.
en: If you will join me, I will have you.
ja: もしあなたがわたしに加わりたいなら、喜んで迎えましょう。

key: It is your right as her daughter.
en: It is your right as her daughter.
ja: それは、彼女の娘であるあなたの権利です。

key: The man ended her life in poison.
en: The man ended her life in poison.
ja: あの男は、毒であなたの母の命を奪いました。

key: When I discovered her IV was laced, I lashed out.
en: When I discovered her IV was laced, I lashed out.
ja: 点滴に毒が仕込まれていたと知った時、わたしは怒りに任せて動きました。

key: One of the few things I can still take pride in is that man's scream as he pulled the syringe from his bleeding eye.
en: One of the few things I can still take pride in is that man's scream as he pulled the syringe from his bleeding eye.
ja: 今でも誇りに思えることの一つは、あの男が血を流す目から注射器を引き抜いた時の悲鳴です。

key: He lived, but his wound is a mark on his life.
en: He lived, but his wound is a mark on his life.
ja: あの男は生き延びましたが、その傷は生涯消えぬ印となったでしょう。

key: Since then, I coveted the venom that ended Elena's life.
en: Since then, I coveted the venom that ended Elena's life.
ja: それ以来、わたしはエレナの命を奪った、あの毒に執着するようになりました。

key: From it, I have made poisons to corrupt.
en: From it, I have made poisons to corrupt.
ja: そこから、腐敗させるための毒を作りました。

key: Poisons to control.
en: Poisons to control.
ja: 支配するための毒を。

key: And poisons to deliver retribution upon the guilty.
en: And poisons to deliver retribution upon the guilty.
ja: そして、罪ある者に報いを与えるための毒を。

key: My beautiful daughter,
en: My beautiful daughter,
ja: 美しいわたしの娘へ、

key: I could not be more proud of you for inheriting all of her friends, her strengths, and her passions.
en: I could not be more proud of you for inheriting all of her friends, her strengths, and her passions.
ja: 彼女の友人たちも、強さも、情熱も、すべて受け継いだあなたを、これ以上ないほど誇りに思います。

key: Someday, we will settle this together."
en: Someday, we will settle this together."
ja: いつか、共にこれに決着をつけましょう。」

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 11!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 11!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解析データ11を手に入れた!

key: Info on Corrosive Mist Field now available!
en: Info on Corrosive Mist Field now available!
ja: 腐食ミストフィールドの情報が見られるようになった!
